grain: date x bakery_id x product_id with positive observed sales

fields.demand_lower_bound: Observed sales; exact on clean rows and a lower bound on stockout rows.
fields.imputed_demand: Estimated post-stockout demand, never taken from another SKU.
fields.demand_upper_guardrail: Observed sales plus the configured per-case reconstruction cap.
fields.is_clear_stockout: Accepted observable stockout signal for this SKU-day.
fields.reconstruction_confidence: Evidence for the imputation: observed, high, medium, or insufficient.
fields.suggested_training_weight: Offline starting weight; not a production policy.
